channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: GBP/USD Price Forecast: US-Iran reaches deal supports advance beyond 20-day EMA
item.description: The GBP/USD pair trades 0.35% higher to near 1.3460 during the late Asian trading session on Monday. The Cable extends its week-long advance as market sentiment improves further, following the announcement that the United States (US) and Iran have reached a deal.

item.title: Euro climbs above 1.1600 on US–Iran peace breakthrough
item.description: The EUR/USD pair gains traction to near 1.1610 during the early European trading hours on Monday. The reports that the US and Iran have reached a deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz improved risk sentiment, supporting the Euro (EUR) against the US Dollar (USD).

item.title: Gold gains momentum as US, Iran announce a peace deal
item.description: Gold price (XAU/USD) rises to a weekly high during the early European trading hours on Monday. The precious metal rebounds after the United States (US) and Iran had reached a deal to end their conflict, easing concerns about inflation and higher interest rates.

item.title: Indian Rupee surges as oil prices nosedive on US-Iran MoU finalization
item.description: The Indian Rupee (INR) opens strongly against the US Dollar (USD) at the start of the week. The USD/INR pair plunges to near 94.60 as oil prices have nosedived, following the announcement that the United States (US) and Iran have reached a permanent peace deal.

item.title: Australian Dollar strengthens on risk-on mood
item.description: AUD/USD gains around 0.5% after registering minor losses in the previous day, trading around 0.7080 during the Asian hours on Monday.

item.title: India Gold price today: Gold rises, according to FXStreet data
item.description: Gold prices rose in India on Monday, according to data compiled by FXStreet.

item.title: AUD/JPY Price Forecast: Strengthens above 113.00, positive tone remains intact
item.description: The AUD/JPY cross trades in positive territory around 113.35 during the early European session on Monday. The reports that the United States (US) had agreed to a peace deal with Iran provide some support to the riskier assets, such as the Australian Dollar (AUD) against the Japanese Yen (JPY).

item.title: United States Dollar Index drops as safe-haven demand fades
item.description: The US Dollar Index (DXY), which measures the value of the US Dollar (USD) against six major currencies, is losing ground and trading around 99.50 during the Asian hours on Monday.

item.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD soars to near $70.80 as US-Iran reach peace deal
item.description: Silver price (XAG/USD) is up 4% to near $70.80 in the Asian trading session on Monday.

item.title: New Zealand Dollar gains on easing risk aversion
item.description: NZD/USD gains ground after registering minor losses in the previous day, trading around 0.5850 during the Asian hours on Monday. The pair remains stronger as the New Zealand Dollar (NZD) holds ground following the release of domestic economic data.

item.title: Japanese Yen flatlines on US-Iran deal, BoJ rate hike expectations
item.description: The USD/JPY pair trades on a flat note near 160.20 during the Asian trading hours on Monday. The US Dollar (USD) softens against the Japanese Yen (JPY) after reports that the United States (US) had agreed to a peace deal with Iran.

item.title: UK, France, Germany and Italy ready to lift Iran sanctions after US-Iran agreement — Reuters
item.description: The United Kingdom (UK), France, Germany ‌and Italy said that the countries were prepared to lift sanctions on Iran in response to steps on its nuclear program after the United States (US) and Iran reached a deal to end their conflict, Reuters reported on Sunday.

item.title: Canadian Dollar rises as US Dollar declines on fading safe-haven demand
item.description: USD/CAD depreciates after two days of gains, trading around 1.3970 during the Asian hours on Monday. The currency pair is under downward pressure as the US Dollar declines broadly, driven by a sharp reduction in market risk aversion.

item.title: PBOC sets USD/CNY reference rate at 6.8088 vs. 6.8109 previous
item.description: On Monday, the People’s Bank of China (PBOC) sets the USD/CNY central rate for the trading session ahead at 6.8088 compared to the previous day's fix of 6.8109 and 6.7544 Reuters estimate.

item.title: British Pound rises as market sentiment improves on US-Iran peace deal
item.description: GBP/USD gains ground after registering minor losses in the previous day, trading around 1.3450 during the Asian hours on Monday.

item.title: Euro advances as US-Iran peace deal weighs on US Dollar
item.description: EUR/USD rises after registering minor losses in the previous day, trading around 1.1610 during the Asian hours on Monday.

item.title: WTI falls to two-month low near $79.50 on US-Iran agreement
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI), the US crude oil benchmark, is trading around $79.40 during the early Asian trading hours on Monday. The WTI price tumbles to a two-month low after reports that the United States (US) and Iran announced a peace deal to end their nearly four-month war.

item.title: US President Donald Trump claims Strait will be ‘permanently toll free’ under Iran agreement
item.description: US President Trump said that the agreement he reached with Iran would ultimately assure that the Strait of Hormuz is “permanently toll free,” the New York Times reported on Sunday.

item.title: Australian Dollar advances above 0.7050 as US and Iran announce a peace deal
item.description: The AUD/USD pair gathers strength to around 0.7075 during the early Asian session on Monday.

item.title: US and Iran agree on peace deal to end war and reopen Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Pakistan Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif said that the United States (US) and Iran have agreed on a deal to bring their nearly four-month war to an end, with both sides declaring the immediate and permanent termination of military operations on all fronts, including in Lebanon, Bloomberg reported on S

item.title: Forecasting the upcoming week: Fed, BoJ, BoE and RBA decisions take center stage
item.description: The US Dollar Index (DXY) lost ground during the week, down 0.27% to trade near the 99.80 level as investors prepared for a heavy central bank calendar the following week.

item.title: South Korean Won: Authorities step up FX stabilisation push – Societe Generale
item.description: Societe Generale highlights that South Korean authorities have launched a multi-pronged FX stabilisation package to address short-term USD funding stress and speculative pressures on the Korean Won.

item.title: US Senior Official: Iran deal secures Hormuz reopening, nuclear material
item.description: A senior administration official said on Friday that the Iran deal will guarantee long-term peace in the region. The agreement would achieve core US objectives and reopen the Strait of Hormuz. The official said that the US would get enriched nuclear material and include an inspection regime.

item.title: United Kingdom: Growth resilience but softer inflation – Deutsche Bank
item.description: Deutsche Bank’s Sanjay Raja says the UK economy is tracking close to the Bank of England’s Scenario A, with stronger‑than‑expected early‑2026 GDP but a cooling labour market and easing price pressures.

item.title: Gold clears $4,200 as optimism on Middle East deal dents inflation woes
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) price consolidates above the $4,200 figure on Friday as market participants are optimistic about a potential US-Iran deal, set to be signed next week, according to newswires. Meanwhile, households in the US are becoming more optimistic about the economy.

item.title: South Korean Won: Supported by equities and hawkish BoK – BBH
item.description: Brown Brothers Harriman’s Elias Haddad highlights strong South Korean asset performance, with South Korean Won (KRW) outperforming and the KOSPI up sharply on AI-led semiconductor strength.

item.title: USD/CAD Price Forecast: RSI enters overbought territory as bears defend 1.4000
item.description: USD/CAD trades on the front foot on Friday as lower Oil prices weigh on the commodity-linked Canadian Dollar (CAD) amid cautious optimism that the United States (US) and Iran could reach an agreement that would reopen the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Japanese Yen: Weakness raises intervention concerns – Scotiabank
item.description: Scotiabank strategists Shaun Osborne and Eric Theoret report USD/JPY is steady but elevated, with recent gains already surpassing prior intervention-trigger levels. A 25 bps Bank of Japan (BoJ) hike on Tuesday is widely anticipated, and markets price nearly one more increase by December.

item.title: Euro holds steady against the US Dollar as markets await clarity on a possible US-Iran peace deal
item.description: EUR/USD fluctuates between modest gains and losses heading into the weekend as traders await Tehran's decision on a possible agreement with the United States (US) to end the war in the Middle East. At the time of writing, the pair trades around 1.1573 and is on track to post modest weekly gains.

item.title: Chinese Yuan: Policy mix supports stability – Societe Generale
item.description: Societe Generale notes that Chinese inflation remains subdued, with May Consumer Price Index (CPI) at 1.2% and core at 1.1%, while PPI has risen to a four-year high, suggesting weak consumer demand and margin pressure.
